gate1_diagnosis.why_x50_was_10p49: At x=50 (a=5.332e-04 = 1.54*a_eq), GR_pure_radiation had Omega_m=0 so Phi_rad decayed as x^-2 to 0.002915, while Cosh (Omega_phi=0.26) had already entered equality. When compared apples-to-apples against matched LCDM (Omega_m=0.26), the potential and DM contrast ratios tell the true dynamical story.
